title: Upload a file to Google Drive with AI to a chosen folder
h1: ask ai to upload a file into the right google drive folder
description: Put a file up to 5 MB into the Google Drive folder you choose. Find the destination first, then open the saved copy where you expect it.
keyword: upload google drive file with ai
answer: **put the approved poster where the printer can find it.** give the bot a file up to 5 mb and a google drive folder. it creates a new copy rather than replacing an older file. a bad or missing destination can silently send it to drive's top level. uploads bypass sending approval, so ask for the folder preview before it writes.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: a small file, in the folder you confirmed.
what:
**attach the file and name its home.** drop it into chat with a clear filename, file type and destination. the bot finds the folder before uploading.

several folders can share a name. use the folder link when names overlap. after the upload, open that folder and the new file together.
uses: **event artwork:** put the approved poster pdf in the event folder.
**a client handover:** upload a small signed certificate to the right folder.
**report delivery:** save the bot's report in your reporting folder.
**project reference:** add an image without moving existing files.

routine.message: every thursday at 1, look in the approved posters folder in the project folder i gave you. find new pdfs that aren't yet in the hollymere exhibition prints folder on google drive. compare each file's size with the 5 mb limit. show its filename, type and proposed drive folder here. ask me before you change anything. upload only the files i choose, then return each saved file and its actual folder. stop if the folder is missing or ambiguous. never replace, delete or upload a second copy.
routine.needs: access to the approved posters project folder; google drive read and write for finding, uploading and locating saved files
routine.output:
upload proposal
- file: hollymere-exhibition-poster.pdf
- type: pdf
- size: within 5 mb
- destination: exhibition prints folder, found in drive

jess's approved artwork is ready for the exhibition prints folder.

steps: **allow the needed actions.** connect drive with read and write for uploads and location checks.
**provide one file.** attach it and ask the bot to find the destination folder.
**review the preview.** review the name, type, size and folder. tell it to ask first.
**open the result.** open the file in its actual drive folder. schedule new files from a project folder only after that works.
watch: **5 mb is this action's limit.** drive's storage allowance does not make this upload larger.
**find the existing copy before uploading again.** each upload creates another file.

faq.q: why did the upload appear outside my folder?
faq.a: **the folder choice may have failed.** a missing or wrong folder can send the file to drive's top level. inspect its actual location.

faq.q: can it upload the file i drop into dusk chat?
faq.a: **yes, within 5 mb.** attach it or drop it in chat. the bot still needs drive write access and the right filename and type.

steps: name the drive folder and ask the bot to find it
read the proposed filename and folder link

mistakes.fix: open the new file and read its folder location.
look for the existing copy first.

tip.text: give the printer a file in the right folder, not a treasure hunt.

items: the filename and type match the file
